settings.breed_blurb: Noble, intelligent and commanding — German Shepherds wear ethnic outfits with unmistakable regal authority.
settings.tip_lehenga: Choose full lehengas with wide neck openings and good shoulder room — German Shepherds have a deep chest and strong shoulders.
settings.tip_sherwani: A classic long sherwani in deep navy or black looks commanding on a German Shepherd. Ensure the back length is at least 62–65 cm.
settings.tip_tshirt: Stretchy XL tees with a relaxed fit are ideal. Avoid anything too fitted around the chest or shoulders.
settings.tip_colours: Black, charcoal, deep burgundy and midnight blue look stunning against the German Shepherd's black-and-tan coat.
